Motor Components.name: Copper
Motor Components.reasoning: Copper is essential for the motor windings as the primary electrical conductor, universally used due to its high electrical conductivity and ductility.

Motor Components.name: Silicon
Motor Components.reasoning: Silicon is used in the semiconductor elements of control electronics and possibly in silicon steel laminations for the stator core to reduce eddy current losses.

Motor Components.name: Iron
Motor Components.reasoning: Iron forms the core of the motor (stator and rotor core), providing magnetic properties essential for motor operation, with very high confidence as it is industry standard.

Motor Components.name: Aluminum
Motor Components.reasoning: Aluminum is commonly used for rotor bars in squirrel cage rotors and some windings due to its lower cost and weight; less conductive than copper but still common.

Motor Components.name: Steel Ingots
Motor Components.reasoning: Steel is often used in structural elements of the motor components, laminations, and shafts due to strength and magnetic properties, widely standard with few alternatives.

Gearbox.name: Steel Ingots
Gearbox.reasoning: Steel is the primary material for gears due to its strength, toughness, wear resistance, and durability, absolutely essential.

Gearbox.name: Aluminum
Gearbox.reasoning: Aluminum may be used for gearbox housings and casings to reduce weight while maintaining adequate strength; common but some designs favor steel.

Gearbox.name: Titanium

Motor Housing.name: Aluminum
Motor Housing.reasoning: Aluminum is almost universally used for motor housings due to lightweight, corrosion resistance, and thermal conductivity with very high confidence.

Motor Housing.name: Steel Ingots
Motor Housing.reasoning: Steel is also used in some motor housing designs for strength and durability, though heavier than aluminum; fairly common alternative.

Bearings.name: Steel Ingots
Bearings.reasoning: Steel, particularly bearing steels, is absolutely essential for bearings due to high strength, hardness, and wear resistance; no alternative matches performance.

Bearings.name: Chromium
Bearings.reasoning: Chromium is used in bearing steel alloys (such as chromium steel) to provide hardness and corrosion resistance; very standard and critical.

Bearings.name: Ceramic
Bearings.reasoning: Ceramic materials may be used in some specialized bearings for high speed or temperature; moderately confident as niche alternative to steel.

End Shields.name: Aluminum
End Shields.reasoning: Aluminum is commonly used for end shields due to good strength-to-weight ratio and corrosion resistance; standard in most designs.

End Shields.name: Steel Ingots
End Shields.reasoning: Steel is sometimes used for end shields for higher mechanical strength but heavier weight; moderately confident.

Cooling System Assembly.name: Aluminum
Cooling System Assembly.reasoning: Aluminum is widely used in cooling system parts like radiators and heat sinks due to excellent thermal conductivity and lightweight.

Cooling System Assembly.name: Copper
